sources.title: sh0wie/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-REAP-288-bf16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It makes the same build faster (see the table below), but everything you need to run REAP-288 today works without it. If you just want to run the model Use the 4-bit build: sh0wie/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-REAP-288-MLX-4bit.

sources.title: sh0wie/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-REAP-288-Q8E-MLX · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with 288 of 512 experts per MoE layer, pruned with REAP saliency calibrated on the quantized weights, and the surviving expert tensors re-quantized to 8-bit. The backbone (attention, DeltaNet, norms, embeddings) stays at 4-bit, so all of the extra 32 GB over the plain 4-bit prune goes to expert precision. Loads on stock mlx-vlm with no patches.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next upgrades the model systematically along four aspects — attention, residual, embedding and optimization — improving model capability while further optimizing computational efficiency, model capacity and training stability: Attention A GDN + QSA hybrid architecture.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | vLLM Recipes - recipes.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen4 architecture preview with a 125B-parameter main model, supplemented by an additional 51B N-gram embeddings, with 6B parameters activated per token.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash is the latest multimodal model from the Qwen family, combining powerful reasoning and generation with remarkable speed. It natively supports a million-token context window, allowing it to process lengthy documents, entire codebases, and complex conversations in a single pass.
